scenes.narration: A short test of the timeline scene, showing events one after another along a line.

scenes.title: A product launch in four weeks

steps.label: Plan and scope
steps.detail: Agree the goals and the date
steps.narration: The first week is for planning, agreeing the goals, and fixing the launch date.

steps.label: Build the core
steps.detail: Ship the main flow end to end
steps.narration: In week two the team builds the core flow and gets it working from start to end.

steps.label: Test with users
steps.narration: Week three puts the product in front of testers, and the team fixes what they find.

steps.label: Launch
steps.narration: Finally the launch goes out, and the team watches the first numbers come in.

steps.label: Review
steps.narration: The fifth week looks back at what went well and what did not go well.

steps.label: Plan next
steps.narration: The sixth week picks the next goals and starts the cycle again.

steps.label: Rest
steps.narration: The seventh week is a short break before the next round of work begins.
Time runs from the left end of the line to the right end.
Each event appears as it is explained, with the line filling up to it.
